pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Fully adapted to the Nether. Immune to fire, lava, and Wither effect.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II + Fire Resistance.

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Melee/Archer mode fires fire charges (20 damage, 5s burn, 3s cooldown).

Aura (16 blocks): hostile Nether mobs cannot target. Owner gets continuous Fire Resistance + lava movement speed freedom.

Nether Sword synergy: all burn durations doubled.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Nether Doll Head, then the Nether Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.
